title: Toy store huge slide
content: After giving it some thought, I think this counts as a "mall world" experience, but I'll take it down if it isn't. I actually don't know if this is even from a dream or from a memory, I just know the data's in my brain and I don't know where it came from. Anyway, here's the description: I'm on top of a very tall slide, and I don't want to go down, but there's a line behind me and they won't let me back off, they're pushing up against me and sounding more and more irritated "just go!" It's a dark green slide, one of those half-tube looking kind. What makes this experience odd is that it's in a seemingly never-ending room. It literally goes on longer than I can even see. For some reason, I think it is in a large toy store. Tall boxes of colorful toys, against the sterilized clean silver of most of this store. Eventually I do go down the slide, but I don't remember doing so. I just know that I got down somehow, because next I know I'm headed for the glass doors at the front of the place. Ok so not much to go on, because this is very fragmented and cloudy. I'm not sure if it's an early childhood memory or a dream or maybe both- I do know that there was a hotel I stayed at once with a similar green waterslide, but it was in a "country" themed indoor waterpark and was not some sterilized clean silver infinity room, and the waterslide was a full tube, not a half tube. [the real life waterpark](https://www.explorebranson.com/sites/default/files/styles/listing_image/public/listing_images/6022-splash%201.jpg?itok=GkCU8Zjl) Also a video game I liked to play about that same time in my life did involve a large toy store, and looking at it does remind me of this dream/memory thing even though it doesn't look alike very much. [video game level](https://youtu.be/mHwQmXbQLC4?t=1018)
